record.content: The EBRPD To Reach The Park section links 43600 Mission Boulevard for the Ohlone College entrance, a coordinate pin at 37.527465089624, -121.912493393071 for the Anza–Pine walk-in entrance, and a coordinate pin at 37.5044641253631, -121.908478932501 for the Stanford Avenue entrance. Its separate directions shortcut resolves to the Stanford Avenue Staging Area. The address-map URL includes a map-view center, but that center is not asserted as an authoritative entrance coordinate.
